assignment: Independently audit the r1 census, r2 verifier, r3 prune evidence, and r4 vault verifier.
verdict: MIXED — r1 and r3 claims agree; r2 and r4 artifacts pass their checks but expose an unsafe local-master fallback, and r4's read-only attestation conflicts with its own incident evidence.

round_1_census.summary: 64/64 seat fragments and 246 evidence rows match the summary; all 109 files added by b2f2efa occur in the census and their introducing commits are ancestors of origin/master.

round_2_tool_build.verdict: MIXED — literal spec conformance passes; safety semantics have an open defect
round_2_tool_build.summary: Installed souji-verify.sh is byte-identical to impl-12 and its 24-check selftest passes. Independently reproduced J3: with zero origin refs, AGENTS.md is reported SAFE(pushed) via refs/heads/master. The binding spec explicitly permits this local-master fallback, so this is a semantic/spec safety gap rather than a literal implementation mismatch.

round_3_prunes.summary: The consolidated actionable list is 96/96 unique, present, and has introducing commits ancestral to origin/master. The four shards contain 111 rows; 15 are already-removed no-ops, as the final report states. Current worktree counts and three withheld unpushed branches match the report.

round_4_vault_verify.verdict: MIXED — installed verifier passes; semantic and rail findings remain
round_4_vault_verify.summary: Installed vault verifier is byte-identical to impl-20 and passes all 35 selftests. It reproduces the same SAFE(pushed) local-master fallback with no origin refs. Separately, the round report's 'vault read-only throughout' claim is contradicted by S53/S58 artifacts documenting an app launch and .obsidian config mtime changes from an earlier harness bug; the artifacts report no note changes and remediation.

defects_found.finding: Both pushed verifiers accept refs/heads/master as proof of a pushed receipt when refs/remotes/origin has no refs. On this lane, AGENTS.md's introducing commit is only shown to be an ancestor of the local master ref; the tools nevertheless emit SAFE(pushed)/VERIFIED(pushed). This cannot establish that the commit reached a remote. The current r2 spec does allow the local-master fallback, so amend the policy/spec and both tools before relying on SAFE(pushed) as proof of push.
defects_found.reproduction: origin_ref_count=0; intro=ccbb1326204bbf21034820430e9923cb96ef4c17; ancestor_of_local_master_exit=0; r2 output SAFE pushed with ref=refs/heads/master; r4 output SAFE pushed and VERIFIED(pushed).

defects_found.finding: The r4 report says the vault was read-only throughout. tests/results/vadv-53.json itself records .obsidian/core-plugins.json and app.json mtime changes from an app launch triggered by an earlier harness bug; census/round-4/seat-58-rail-breach.json records VIOLATED-THEN-REMEDIATED and identifies backtick command substitution. The artifacts say no markdown notes changed; treat this as a historical configuration-write incident and correct the broad attestation. The live incident was not re-run in this read-only audit.
